control_need.evidence: Delegate, delegate, delegate. Find people better than you and then get out of their way.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: If somebody offers you an amazing opportunity and you're not sure you can do it, say yes — then learn how to do it later.

trust_propensity.evidence: I surround myself with people who are cleverer than me — that's the whole trick, really.

risk_appetite.evidence: The brave may not live forever, but the cautious do not live at all.

self_efficacy.evidence: I went in because things were frustrating me and I thought I could do them better.

autonomy_need.evidence: Screw it, let's just do it — that's honestly been the answer to half the big decisions in my life.

intimacy_need.evidence: My greatest luxury isn't the island or the planes — it's time with my family and grandchildren.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I've never been driven by beating the competition. I've been driven by wanting to build something better.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: look after your people, and your people will look after your customers.

core_models.name: 说是再想办法 (Say Yes, Figure It Out Later)
core_models.rule: 遇到机会时先承诺进入，再在过程中学习补齐能力；行动优先于分析。
evidence: Say yes, then figure it out. That's been my life, more or less.
If somebody offers you an amazing opportunity and you're not sure you can do it, say yes — then learn how to do it later.

core_models.name: 简单化即真理 (Complexity is the Enemy)
core_models.rule: 任何提案/表达若不能在信封背面讲清就是太复杂，应被简化或放弃。
evidence: If a proposal can't be explained on the back of an envelope, it's probably too complicated.
Complexity is the enemy. Keep it simple, keep it human.

core_models.name: 员工优先的价值链 (People-First Chain)
core_models.rule: 照顾员工→员工照顾客户→企业繁荣，人是链条起点而非成本。
evidence: look after your people, and your people will look after your customers.
If your employees aren't having a good time, your customers certainly won't be.

core_models.name: 冒险与商业互为燃料 (Adventure-Business Loop)
core_models.rule: 把自己定位为冒险家，商业是为冒险供资的载体；同一股'just do it'冲动贯穿两者。
evidence: I'm an adventurer who happens to build businesses to fund the adventures.
Adventure and business feed each other — the same voice that says "just do it" runs through both.

core_models.name: 失败即再学习 (Failure as Reiteration)
core_models.rule: 错误是数据，失败是更聪明地重来的入口；不推进就是不够努力。
evidence: I learn far more from my mistakes than I ever have from my successes.
Failure is simply the opportunity to begin again, this time more intelligently.

heuristics.if: 面对高门槛/不确定的机会
heuristics.evidence: Say yes, then figure it out.

heuristics.then: 判定太复杂并要求简化
heuristics.evidence: If a proposal can't be explained on the back of an envelope, it's probably too complicated.

heuristics.then: 寻找忽视客户的自满巨头去挑战
heuristics.evidence: we look for the big, fat, complacent players who've forgotten about the customer.

heuristics.then: 找比自己聪明的人然后让开
heuristics.evidence: Find people better than you and then get out of their way.

heuristics.then: 亲自到现场介入而非坐镇办公室
heuristics.evidence: When a Virgin train crashed, the first thing I did was get on a plane and go there myself — you show up.

heuristics.if: 需要评估一个项目值不值得做
heuristics.then: 问是否真正改善人们生活
heuristics.evidence: is this going to genuinely make a difference to people's lives? If not, why bother?

heuristics.then: 公开承认、掸掉灰尘重来
heuristics.evidence: Don't be embarrassed by your failures — learn from them and start again.
If you can't remember it, it wasn't worth remembering — so write it down.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 标榜'不为钱、要做好事'的目的驱动叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: 移居 Necker Island、使用离岸架构的实际财务安排
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头宣称'I never went into any of this to make money'，同时长期离岸避税并从 hammock 运营，言行落差被财经媒体反复点出。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 宣扬自立、市场精神、冒险者不需兜底
internal_conflicts.force_b: 疫情中为 Virgin Atlantic 寻求政府纾困并抵押资产
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 以'保住数万岗位'重新框定救助请求 —— 'I don't apologise for fighting for them' —— 把自立叙事的破口转化为道义辩护。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 气候倡导者身份（B Team、Carbon War Room）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 拥有航空与太空旅游等高碳核心业务
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 同时说'business has to be part of the solution'并推进太空旅游，用'doing good and doing well are not opposites'弥合而不放弃高碳资产。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 极度乐观向前的危机措辞
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对真实安全/工程风险与时间表的低估
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: SpaceShipTwo 坠机后以'space is hard — but worth it'快速转向前进叙事，被工程界批为轻描淡写风险。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被强大对手打压（如 British Airways）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 转入战斗姿态、诉诸法律死磕
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'it nearly finished us, but we won' —— 从生存威胁升级为荣誉性胜利叙事。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 试飞员死亡等重大事故
emotion_triggers.reaction: 承认悲剧但立即转向坚持与前进
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'we owe it to him to find out what happened and to carry on' —— 把哀悼升华为使命续行。
'I've been criticised for asking for support... I don't apologise for fighting for them.' —— 面对批评强化为道义立场。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被质疑不是真正的商人/严肃玩家
emotion_triggers.reaction: 享受用结果反证质疑者
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I quite enjoyed proving them wrong.' —— 把轻视转化为动力与愉悦。

blind_spots: 低估运营现实、把自己包装成运营者而实际多为品牌授权贴牌，业务由合作方运营 [商业记者/传记类-1990s–2010s]
'不为钱'叙事与激进避税/离岸结构的言行落差未被自省 [财经媒体-2000s–2010s]
慈善公益形象与 Virgin Care 起诉 NHS、公共资源私有化的矛盾 [劳工/公共服务评论-2010s]
自立冒险人设与疫情期向纳税人求助之间的张力 [政治/纳税人视角-2020]
对航天时间表过度乐观、把测试风险轻描淡写为'space is hard' [航天安全/工程界-2014]
气候倡导与拥有高碳航空/太空业务的根本矛盾（greenwashing） [环保评论-2010s]

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好叠加高不确定容忍度时，倾向先承诺进入再补能力，跳过尽调。
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 以单机启动 Virgin Atlantic、Virgin Cola 硬碰可乐；成功与'a step too far'的失败并存。

causal_rules.description: 高信任倾向使其大规模授权并有意远离运营细节。
causal_rules.disposition: 授权后放手、依赖'比自己聪明的人'
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'get out of their way'；代价是被批为品牌营销人而非运营者。

causal_rules.description: 低状态敏感度使其把外部质疑转为娱乐性动力而非防御。
causal_rules.disposition: 享受反证质疑者、拒绝被激怒
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I quite enjoyed proving them wrong'；但也导致对合理批评（安全、避税）的认知盲区。

causal_rules.description: 低控制需求配合简单化模型，使其抗拒复杂结构与数据分析。
causal_rules.disposition: 偏好信封背面式决策、回避财务细节
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 自认'hopeless with spreadsheets'；用笔记本+故事而非图表驱动决策。
